# Legacy Format Course (about 1 hours)

Edge-case fixture (T0.5b): a course in the legacy format. It has no Library Data section, so the app derives IDs from the module numbers.

What is one? (1) A number. (2) A symbol.

## Module 2 · Next steps

**link:** D2

Plain text for module two.

## Practice Lab

**Q1.** Pick the first item. (mcq) A. alpha · B. beta · C. gamma · D. delta

**Q2.** Which two are vowels? (select two) A. apple · B. bread · C. egg · D. zebra

**Q3.** What is two plus two? (numeric) Enter a whole number.

**Q4.** Describe a vowel in one sentence. (short answer) Write your answer.

## Answer Key

| Q | Answer | Domain | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | A | D1 | Alpha is first. |
| 2 | A, C | D2 | Apple and egg start with vowels. |
| 3 | 4 ± 0 | D1 | Two plus two is four. |
| 4 | model answer | D2 | Open answer. |
